paper_title: Iron nitrate and 4-OH-TEMPO-cocatalyzed aerobic oxidation of isochromans†

questions.question: In this paper, what chemical species is denoted by the label "1a"?
questions.ground_truth_answer: 1a refers to the isochroman substrate shown in the paper (the parent isochroman used as the model substrate in Schemes/Table; the starting material for formation of lactone 2a).

questions.question: What is the molecular identity/structure of product 2a as depicted in the paper?
questions.ground_truth_answer: 2a is the oxidized lactone (isochromanone) product derived from 1a — the benzofused lactone structure shown in Scheme 1/2 and throughout the paper (the isochroman → isochromanone/lactone product).

questions.question: What were the standard reaction conditions (catalysts, solvent and atmosphere) used to convert 1a to 2a in the paper?
questions.ground_truth_answer: 5 mol% Fe(NO3)3·9H2O and 5 mol% 4-OH-TEMPO in MeCN with an O2 balloon at room temperature (rt).

questions.question: Under the authors' standard conditions, which product was obtained in a higher isolated/NMR yield: product 2c or product 2k?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Product 2c gave the higher yield (2c: 100% vs. 2k: 71%).
